title: Validate Dynamic HDR preservation with real media
summary: Validated Dolby Vision P8.1 Dynamic HDR preservation through CPU/libx265 using public real media, switched FFmpeg argument generation to the native Dolby Vision encoder option, and kept HDR10+ representative proof open.
reason: The previous x265 capability probe was conservative and then proved the planned dolby-vision-rpu x265 parameter path was not accepted by the bundled FFmpeg/libx265 build. Dolby Vision preservation needed a real capability check and real-media proof before use.
behavior_before: Dynamic HDR encode preservation could resolve to hold_review because x265 Dynamic HDR capability probing was a stub, and the planned Dolby Vision RPU injection path relied on a CLI-only x265 parameter through FFmpeg.
behavior_after: The capability probe detects FFmpeg-native libx265 Dolby Vision support via encoder help and probes HDR10+ with a relative dhdr10-info fixture when supplied. CPU/libx265 Dolby Vision encode plans use -dolbyvision true plus guarded Dolby Vision profile/VBV x265 parameters, while HDR10+ continues to require representative proof.
tests_added: Extended Invoke-DynamicHdrToolingChecks.ps1 with fixture-backed x265 capability coverage for native FFmpeg Dolby Vision support, relative HDR10+ JSON probing, and Dolby-only capability behavior.
Updated Invoke-EncodeFlagPolicyChecks.ps1 Dynamic HDR CPU snapshot to require -dolbyvision true and reject the invalid dolby-vision-rpu x265 parameter path.
